# 🏴‍☠️ STEAMIDRA — GAME FIX & DOWNLOAD SETUP

**Download Steam games · LumaCore · one-click online fixes**

> Set it up once (**Steps 1–4**), then it's just **download → test → fix**. Extra help lives in the buttons below.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 1️⃣ Turn Off Real-Time Protection
Do this **before** installing, or setup files can get deleted mid-install.
**Win key → Virus & Threat Protection → Manage Settings** → turn off **Real-time protection**. Leave the window open for Step 3.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 2️⃣ Install SteaMidra
⭐ **Recommended: [the drappula fork](https://github.com/drappula/SFF/releases/latest)** — fixes a lot of issues in the current build (much faster downloads, no more *"Parsing Lua…"* stalls, games stay on their pinned version).
-# Prefer the original? It's still here: [Midrags/SFF](https://github.com/Midrags/SFF/releases)
1. Download `SteaMidra-X.X.X-Setup.exe` and run it.
2. It installs to `%LocalAppData%\SteaMidra\` — you'll exclude that next.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 3️⃣ Add Exclusions
**Virus & Threat Protection → Exclusions → Add folder** for each of these:
```
%LocalAppData%\SteaMidra\
C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\
```
…plus every other Steam library you have (e.g. `D:\SteamLibrary`).
-# Stops game fixes from getting quarantined after they're applied.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 4️⃣ First-Time Setup (Home Tab)
**Auto LC Setup** → **Block Steam Updates** → **Install LumaCore** (wait for it, then close the prompt).
-# After a Steam update, if SteaMidra offers to **restart Steam**, say yes — it reloads LumaCore support.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 📥 Download a Game
**Store** tab → search your game → **Download**.
-# Download failed? Tap **📥 Download Problems**.

-# ─────────────────────────────────
## 🛠️ Game Won't Launch or No Multiplayer?
Work down this list — **stop as soon as it works:**
**1.** 🎮 **Vanilla** — just launch it. Plenty of games need nothing.
**2.** 🌐 **`-onlinefix`** — pick the game → **Home → LC Online Fix**.
**3.** 🧰 **[OnlineFixManager](https://github.com/j117mw3/OnlineFixManager/releases/latest)** — finds the right Online-Fix files for you and lets you toggle the fix on/off.
-# Full steps for each → tap **🛠️ Fixing a Game**.

footer.text: Recommended: drappula fork • Fix order: vanilla → -onlinefix → OnlineFixManager
